### Gotchas

- **Critical SQL Injection and Hardcoded Credential Vulnerabilities in ProHVAC Admin Routes - 39 security findings: 8 critical SQL injection, 7 hardcoded credentials, 21+ high/medium issues across auth and admin paths.**
  - 7 critical SQL injection vulnerabilities via template literals in server/auth/throttle.js (3), server/routes/admin.content.js (2), server/routes/admin.leads.js (1)
- **Role-based access control implemented via factory pattern with build-time validation - requireRole() creates middleware that validates user roles; ROLES constant enforces valid role names at server startup**
  - User role stored as string property on user object, validated via typeof check and list.includes()
- **Security Scan Reveals 19 Critical, 40 High-Severity Issues - SQL injection, hardcoded credentials, XSS, timing attacks, and unbounded caches identified across codebase**
  - SQL injection (SEC-JS-SQL-TEMPLATE) in server/auth/throttle.js (3 instances), admin.content.js (3 instances), admin.leads.js (1 instance) using template literals instead of parameterized...
- **Bruteforce rate-limiting module not integrated into authentication routes - throttle.js functions registerFailure, detectStuffing, blockIp are unreachable; no active protection**
  - server/routes/admin.auth.js refuse() handler does not call throttle.registerFailure() on password failures
- **Added explicit contentinfo role to footer element for accessibility - role="contentinfo" added to footer tag to preserve semantic landmark after nesting inside main.**
  - Added role="contentinfo" attribute to footer element in Footer.jsx
- **Created test for TOTP setup with expired session (5+ minute pause scenario) - Test case simulates user timeout during 2FA enrollment: login → generate secret → wait → submit code with expired session.**
  - Directly manipulates database via Node.js to set idle_expires_at to past timestamp for pending_totp sessions

### Why things are the way they are

- **Admin CLI tool provides secure bootstrapping and management of admin accounts - Comprehensive CLI with user creation, password reset, 2FA reset, unlock, backup, and maintenance operations**
  - Server runs same maintenance automatically daily (server/index.js); CLI doesn't update last_purge_at to avoid shifting server schedule
- **Increased enrollment session timeout from 5 to 20 minutes - Added ENROLL_TTL_MS constant to allow users adequate time to install authenticator app during 2FA setup.**
  - New constant ENROLL_TTL_MS = 20 * 60_000 added to server/routes/admin.auth.js

### Trade-offs made

- **Rate-limiting and brute-force protection system architecture - SQLite-based multi-layer authentication throttle with honeypot scanner detection and credential stuffing prevention**
  - Honeypot paths (/wp-login.php, /.env, /phpmyadmin, etc.) immediately trigger IP blocking without delay, treating scanner access as definitive evidence
- **ProHVAC Security Architecture: Layered Defense and Path Masking Strategy - Request pipeline applies defense-in-depth via path normalization, IP blocking, admin gate masking, and CSRF barriers before routing to handlers.**
  - server/app.js (448 LOC) implements 6-layer defense: path normalization, security headers, IP blocking, admin gate masking, API routing, then static/SPA fallback

### Problems already solved

- **Fixed rate-limit bucket creation ordering in login handler - Username bucket now only created if IP-level limit not exhausted; prevents table bloat from credential stuffing**
  - Changed condition from `username ? throttle.hit()` to `username && byIp.allowed ? throttle.hit()`
- **Rate-limit bucket created for every unique login even when IP throttled - login:user bucket incremented before IP-level check; unauthenticated stream bloats rate_limit table**
  - admin.auth.js:408 increments login:user:&lt;username&gt; rate limit before checking IP-level byIp.allowed
- **Consolidated garbage collection logic in admin CLI to use maintenance module - Removed duplicate GC code; CLI now calls server/lib/maintenance.js for single source of truth**
  - Removed gcSessions import from session.js; GC logic now in maintenance module

### Established patterns

- **Role assignment and access control patterns identified in codebase - Grep found role assignment logic, access guards, and audit logging across admin, auth, and routes**
  - Role stored as string property on user objects in src/admin/useSession.js
- **pv-shell and pv-section width container usage patterns mapped - pv-shell used in Advantages, Partners, Projects, Stats; Contact uses pv-section**
  - pv-shell container used in multiple components: Advantages.jsx, Partners.jsx, Projects.jsx, Stats.jsx
- **ProHVAC Complete System: Data Flow, Dependency Injection, and Safety Patterns - End-to-end system from startup through lead intake, storage, and export with streaming safety, GDPR compliance, and formula injection protection.**
  - Lead validation is single source of truth (shared/lead.js) used by both frontend (zod schema) and backend to prevent divergence; MarkdownV2 escaping applied to all user values
- **ProHVAC Infrastructure: Encryption, Rate Limiting, and Two-Factor Authentication - Encrypted secret storage with per-purpose AES-256-GCM keys, SQL-backed process-pool-aware rate limiting, and atomic 2FA code redemption patterns.**
  - secretbox.open() throws on authentication failure (not silent); undetected corruption would cause silent data loss in API calls
- **ProHVAC Authentication Lifecycle: Session Management and Admin Path Masking - Complete session lifecycle from creation through rotation with state machine validation; admin path masking via HMAC-signed gate cookie and indistinguishable 404 responses.**
  - Configuration validation (config.js) prevents bitwise errors: checks APP_SECRET ≠ GATE_SECRET, minimum path length 24 chars, rejects dev-insecure prefixes in production

### How it works

- **Footer component structure and CSS constraint variable identified - Footer.jsx applies pv-footer class; --pv-max global constraint is 1320px**
  - Footer.jsx is a simple React component wrapping pv-footer, pv-footer__grid, and pv-footer__bar classes
- **Footer component references mapped across codebase - Grep found footer in 5 files: Footer.jsx, index.css, Home.jsx, Header.jsx, Content.jsx**
  - Footer component exists at src/components/Footer.jsx
- **Multiple Node.js processes running on prohvac project - 12 active Node.js processes detected in Windows environment with varied start times**
  - 12 node.exe processes are currently running on the system
- **Admin and authentication infrastructure mapped across server - 26 files contain admin, password, auth, and bootstrap patterns across server modules**
  - Admin routes module found: server/routes/admin.auth.js (authentication), admin.2fa.js (2FA), admin.content.js, admin.media.js, admin.leads.js, admin.settings.js
- **ProHVAC Repository Structure Mapped - 203-file React codebase with 65K LOC, database layer, and admin routes identified**
  - Database layer present: migrations (001_init.sql), rate limiting, and database initialization in migrate.js
- **ProHVAC Super-Review Complete: Comprehensive Security Architecture Assessment - 39 security findings identified; 8 critical SQL injections in admin handlers undermine otherwise sophisticated defense-in-depth architecture.**
  - Codebase: 127 files, 35,555 LOC, React frontend + Node.js backend with zero runtime dependencies
